summary: B27 — AR Step-by-Step Visual Guidance Runtime — comprehensive backend + frontend validation. All 18 backend pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend testing verified: (a) demo user project workspace shows 'View Steps in AR' banner (proj-ar) that navigates to /home-intel/ar?project_id=..., (b) normal low-risk project (Floating Oak Shelf) → LIMITED 2D guided view with ar-start → instruction runner shows progress '1/10', overlay chip ('Sequence Overlay'), Step 1 body with safety note, all 8 controls present (ar-confirm, ar-skip, ar-show-text, ar-recenter, ar-tracking, ar-pause, ar-safety, ar-exit), (c) hazard project (Replace Main Electrical Panel) → Professional Recommended card with ar-pro and ar-text-fallback; ar-start correctly absent. Admin (Diyhomieapp) side-nav shows 'AR Guidance' (admin-nav-arguidance); ARModule renders session stats (Sessions/Completed/Completion%/Failures), ar-feature-toggle, platform switches (iOS/Android/Web), 9 guidance-type template switches, and Insufficient Tracking failure count. Non-admin (demo_home) receives 403 on all 5 admin AR endpoints. Feature/platform settings restored to defaults (feature_enabled=true, web=false) after admin toggle tests. No deprecated Expo packages introduced in B27.
critical_code_review_comments: ar_guidance_engine.py is well-scoped (~535 lines) and provider-agnostic as designed. Progress updates on hi_project_steps guarded by explicit work_item_confirmed + project_work_item_id — matches spec.

Eligibility PROFESSIONAL_KEYWORDS + HAZARD_HINT gating fires correctly on real seeded 'Replace Main Electrical Panel' project (risk_level=Professional Recommended, status=escalated) via all three conditions (status escalated OR safety_status 'professional' OR risk 'Professional Recommended').
POST /sessions returns 409 with {eligibility, message} in HTTPException detail for UNAVAILABLE/NOT_RECOMMENDED/PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED — never creates a session. Verified.
report-tracking correctly sets session to paused + returns fallback:2d; calibrate anchor_confirmed:false correctly writes insufficient_tracking outcome.
complete with work_item_confirmed:false leaves project step unchanged (work_item_updated:false, note explains); ready for the confirmed variant when a project_work_item_id is passed at session start.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical AR flows verified — user runner, hazard fallback, admin dashboard)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing demo_home projects: 'Install a Floating Oak Shelf' (low-risk, AVAILABLE/LIMITED) and 'Replace Main Electrical Panel' (Professional Recommended, escalated). AR settings singleton auto-seeded on first read. ar_sessions/ar_outcomes/ar_instructions/ar_anchors populated by test suite.
